name: stream

flow.name: album-songs-for-stream-url
flow.notes: data[0] is Solar Wind (songNumber 1, deterministic album ordering). The streamUrl is consumed verbatim by both native clients and is self-authenticating: {baseUrl}/song/stream/{songApiKey}/{userApiKey}/{urlencode(base64(userGuid:songGuid:clientIp|expiryUnix|hmacSha256))}. Secret = user PublicKey; expiry = 7 days; clientBinding = client IP. Only the auth token segment is treated as secret; the recorded stream-step request URLs keep the concrete path shape with the token segment masked.

flow.name: head
flow.notes: MeloAmp probes stream URLs with HEAD first (Player.tsx:132). HEAD returns headers only (Accept-Ranges, Content-Length = full size, Content-Type).

flow.name: get-full
flow.notes: Normal full-file GET. Expect 200, Content-Type audio/wav, Accept-Ranges bytes (PhysicalFileResult, EnableRangeProcessing=true), Content-Length = FileSize.

flow.name: get-range-initial
flow.notes: Initial 1 KiB range (media-player probe pattern). Expect 206 with Content-Range bytes 0-1023/{size}.

flow.name: get-range-open-end
flow.notes: Open-ended range from offset to EOF.

flow.name: get-range-malformed
flow.notes: Malformed range. The legacy server answers 400 'Unable to load song' (RangeParser returns null; controller maps to ApiBadRequest) — NOT RFC 7233's 416. Compatibility-critical.

flow.name: get-range-multipart
flow.notes: Multi-range request: RangeParser.ParseRange (single-range regex) rejects the comma form -> 400 'Unable to load song'. Multipart/byteranges responses are NOT supported.

flow.name: get-with-jwt-query-param
flow.notes: MeloAmp appends ?jwt=<token> for <audio> playback (toQueueSong.ts:40-44). The route is [AllowAnonymous] with path-segment HMAC auth; records that the extra query param is tolerated (the jwt value is redacted in the recorded URL as a sensitive query key AND unsubstituted as a captured secret).

flow.name: get-tampered-token
flow.notes: DISCOVERY: a structurally undecodable authToken (corrupted base64) does NOT produce a clean 401 JSON; FromBase64 throws inside the controller, the error pipeline answers 302 Location: /Account/Login?ReturnUrl=%2FError (Blazor error handling). Captured without following redirects. Valid-format-but-wrong HMAC tokens DO get clean 401 JSON (see get-token-for-wrong-song).

flow.name: get-token-for-wrong-song
flow.notes: Valid token bound to Solar Wind presented for a DIFFERENT song (Neon 東京): token song-guid check must reject. Proves per-song binding.

flow.name: get-unknown-user
flow.notes: Nonexistent (random) userApiKey with a valid token: user lookup fails before token validation -> 401.

flow.name: get-empty-guid-user
flow.notes: DISCOVERY: Guid.Empty as userApiKey takes the exception path (302 to /Account/Login?ReturnUrl=%2FError) instead of the clean 401 a random unknown GUID gets. Undocumented behavioral split in the stream auth pipeline.

notes: PRD-STREAM-001/002 critical path: URL shape, HMAC auth semantics, 200 vs 206, Content-Type/Length/Range, Accept-Ranges, and invalid/unsatisfiable range behavior required by Android Media3/Android Auto and desktop clients.
